# Screenshots (real, generated by E2E)

These PNGs are real Chromium renders produced by `tests/e2e.mjs` against a
live stack — no mocks. Regenerate:

```bash
docker compose up --build -d
cd tests && npm install && node e2e.mjs
```

`e2e.mjs` honors `API_URL` / `WEB_URL` (defaults `http://localhost:8082` and
`http://localhost:3002`) and `CHROME_PATH`. The set committed here was
generated with `API_URL=http://localhost:18082 WEB_URL=http://localhost:13002`
because host port 8082 was already occupied by an unrelated container on the
build machine; page content is identical on the canonical ports.

| File | Page |
|------|------|
| `home.png` | Storefront home with highlights |
| `catalogo.png` | Catalog |
| `produto.png` | Product detail |
| `checkout.png` | Checkout with seeded cart |
| `admin.png` | Admin dashboard (revenue / orders / low-stock / top) |
| `admin-produtos.png` | Admin product management |
